Check Eligibility
Frontier accelerate for Copilot could be right for your organisation if you…
Have 300+ Microsoft 365 licences.
Want to identify where Copilot, Copilot Chat, agents or Agent 365 could create measurable value.
Need to prioritise personas, scenarios and use cases before investing further.
Are preparing to deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot securely and want stronger usage, confidence and measurable outcomes.
Want to design, build or activate agents with the right governance and adoption support.
Want to understand whether Microsoft funding can support your next step.
Three funded engagement routes
Frontier Accelerate for Copilot includes three 1:1 partner-led engagement routes. We will help you choose the right route based on your current position, licence status and goals.
Envisioning & PoC Accelerator
Explore where Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents could create value.
This engagement can help you identify personas and use cases, assess readiness, build the business case and develop a Proof of Concept where appropriate.
Microsoft 365 Copilot Deployment Accelerator
Prepare for and support a secure Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment.
This engagement can cover technical foundations, implementation, training, adoption and change management, with a focus on active use and measurable outcomes.
Agent Solution Deployment Accelerator
Design, build or activate agent solutions around defined business needs.
This engagement can support development, security, governance, training, adoption and change management across Microsoft’s Copilot and agent platforms.
Funding can help you…
Identify high-value Copilot and agent scenarios.
Assess technical, security and governance readiness before scaling.
Understand when to use Copilot tools such as pre-built agents and Cowork effectively.
Build a practical business case and value plan.
Develop a Proof of Concept to test an opportunity.
Deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot with the right controls and support.
Design, build or activate governed agent solutions.
Measure usage, progress and business outcomes.
Recognised Microsoft expertise

The Inform Team is part of Microsoft’s invite-only Copilot & Agents Partner Community and is eligible to claim Frontier Accelerate for Copilot funding, subject to customer eligibility, Microsoft approval and programme terms.

w:r.w:t: Why The Inform Team?
Because Copilot value does not come from licences alone. It comes from choosing the right scenarios, getting the foundations right, and helping people change how work gets done.
People-first
We start with the business problem and the people affected. This keeps funded activity focused on useful outcomes rather than product features.
Practical
We connect discovery, readiness, deployment, adoption and measurement. Each stage leads to a clear next step.
Tailored
We build in security, governance, communications and change management so organisations can scale responsibly.
Microsoft trusts us. Our clients recommend us. And our track record shows we know how to turn Microsoft 365, Copilot and agents into practical business outcomes.
Register your interest to check eligibility and next steps
In simple terms: if you are eligible, Microsoft funding can help reduce the cost of getting expert support to move from Copilot ambition to governed, measurable impact.
